social_security.scope: 50 states and DC after displayed exclusions; Master Beneficiary Record and USPS geography. Includes institutional residents. Excludes lump-sum death payments. Unnegotiated checks not deducted. Geography annual totals are estimated and rounded. Raw HTML download returned403; cells transcribed from primary web-tool rendering, not a local raw HTML archive.

ssi_due.scope: Months due in2024, reduced by overpayment recoveries; excludes state-administered supplementation. Includes recipients outside CPS noninstitutional domain. Timing is not payment-date cash. Raw HTML download returned403; primary rendered cells transcribed.

ssi_cash_federal.scope: Federal only, payment-date CY2024, not reduced for certain overpayments remitted to Treasury; not the same definition as the near-identical SSI ASR63.079493bn federally administered federal-plus-state due total. No state supplements added without a matched timing bridge.
